claims.claim: unstratified Missisquoi Bay, Lake Champlain, is 3–5 m deep
claims.note: The research note (white_perch_habitat_and_predation.md) says gill-net stations were 3.0–4.9 m deep, 24.6–25.4 °C at every station, Secchi 0.65–1.0 m, nets not set shallower than 2.5 m; not verified.

claims.claim: white perch were 65.8 % of the fish in 24-h gill nets
claims.note: The note gives 1,338 of 2,033 fish (16 species), 14 stations, 18–22 August 2003, one 60.8-m multi-mesh net per station lifted after ~24–27 h; not verified.

claims.claim: white perch were caught at all 14 open-bay stations
shore seines at 0.5–2.5 m took white perch at only 8 of 27 stations
claims.note: The note: September seines took 254 white perch averaging ~11 g; not verified.

claims.claim: pike, smallmouth and largemouth were netted at 11, 10 and 5 of the 14 open-bay stations
